name: generate_content
description: Generate a content item for the Goal Digger app, or decide to skip if nothing is newsworthy

is_newsworthy.description: Is this genuinely worth notifying her about? Be honest. When in doubt, skip.

skip_reason.description: If not newsworthy: explain why in one sentence (for internal logging only)

newsworthiness_score.description: 1-10 scale. 1 = routine/boring, 5 = mildly interesting, 8 = definitely tell her, 10 = huge breaking news. Only publish if 6+.

headline.description: 1-2 sentence push notification text. Max 200 characters. Must hook her in 3 seconds.

body.description: Full detail view content in markdown. 3-5 short paragraphs. Scannable in 60 seconds.

talking_points.description: 3-5 conversation starters. Each should be something she can naturally say or ask.

emotional_context.description: The emotional tone of this news. Used to potentially style the notification.

source_summary.description: One-line summary of which source(s) this content is based on (for internal audit)
